Requirements and portal options can change. Check the live official system before paying, transferring, leaving Saudi Arabia or assuming a case has been cleared.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is huroob in Saudi Arabia?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Huroob is the common expat name for an absence or absconding-related labour status. Saudi official systems now commonly use wording such as work discontinuation or absent from work. Always check the exact status in Qiwa or the relevant official system.

What does 'escape report of resident ID number has been recorded' mean?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

It usually indicates that an absence-related report or status has been recorded against the resident's Iqama or employment record. The English wording can be a translated system phrase, so check Qiwa, the official action date and your exact status before deciding what to do.

How do I check if I have huroob or absent-from-work status?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Open Qiwa Individuals and check your employer, contract and employment status. Save any work-discontinuation or absent-from-work message and the official date. Also check Absher for connected residency and visa information.

How many days do I have after work discontinuation?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The standard private-sector procedure gives a 60-day period from the official work-discontinuation action date for an eligible worker to complete a transfer or final exit.

Can I transfer to another employer during the 60 days?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

An eligible worker may be able to transfer. The new employer normally starts the request in Qiwa, adds the employment contract and completes the connected government process. Live Qiwa eligibility controls the result.

Can I get final exit during the 60-day period?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The standard procedure provides a final-exit option for eligible workers during the allowed period. Check the live Qiwa and Absher record, passport, Iqama and any unresolved violations before relying on it.

What happens when the 60 days expire?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The status can become or remain absent from work, and the normal transfer and final-exit requests may stop being accepted. Some professional workers may qualify for the status-correction initiative launched by MHRSD in September 2025.

How can I remove huroob in Saudi Arabia?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

There is no universal one-click removal. If you are inside the 60-day period, an eligible transfer or final exit may solve the status. Older professional-worker cases may qualify for the Qiwa correction initiative. False reports should be challenged through MHRSD and the appropriate labour-dispute route. Domestic workers use Musaned.

Can my employer cancel a private-sector absence report?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The published private-sector procedural guide describes the standard submitted work-discontinuation action as non-retractable by the employer after submission. A false or incorrect case can still be reported, disputed and formally reviewed through MHRSD or other competent channels.

What should I do if the employer filed a false huroob report?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Save attendance, salary, Qiwa, leave, medical and message evidence immediately. Report the possible labour violation to MHRSD. If you also have personal claims such as unpaid wages or unlawful termination, use Friendly Settlement. Do not assume the complaint pauses the 60-day system period.

Can I clear an old absent-from-work status through Qiwa?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

MHRSD launched a Qiwa initiative in September 2025 for specified professional workers with absent-from-work status. Important conditions include at least 12 continuous months in Saudi Arabia before the relevant event and the new employer agreeing to pay outstanding work-permit financial charges. Check live Qiwa eligibility.

Does huroob mean I lose all unpaid salary?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

No. Unpaid salary is a separate employment claim. Keep wage records and use the official labour-dispute route if the employer does not pay what is legally due.

Does huroob mean I automatically lose end-of-service benefits?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

No single answer applies to every case. EOSB can depend on how the contract legally ended. If an employer validly terminates under Article 80, the award can be affected. If Article 80 does not legally apply, the result may be different. Keep evidence and use the official dispute route where needed.

Can I work for another company before the transfer is completed?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Do not start unauthorised work. The new employment relationship and required work authorisation should be completed through the official transfer process first.

Is absent from work the same as exited and did not return?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

No. Absent from work is mainly an employment-status issue. Exited and did not return concerns a worker who is outside Saudi Arabia after an exit-and-re-entry problem and is handled through different immigration records.

Do domestic workers follow the same huroob rules?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

No. Domestic workers normally use Musaned and separate rules. Published controls include a 15-day employer withdrawal period in qualifying cases. Current MHRSD guidance also distinguishes workers whose contracts end for work discontinuation during the first two years after entry from workers who have been in Saudi Arabia for more than two years.

Can an agent guarantee huroob removal?![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

No legitimate agent can guarantee a government decision. Use Qiwa, MHRSD, Absher, Musaned and authorised legal channels. Never pay for a fake transfer or share your Absher, Nafath, Qiwa or bank verification codes.

## [Bottom Line](#bottom-line)

A Saudi huroob or absconding case is not one simple status with one simple solution.

Start by checking the **exact official status and date**.

For many standard private-sector work-discontinuation cases, the worker has **60 days** to complete an eligible transfer to a new employer or final exit. If no action is completed, the status can become absent from work and the normal route can become much harder.

If the report is false, collect evidence and use the official MHRSD violation and labour-dispute channels immediately.

If the 60-day period has already passed, check whether the September 2025 professional-worker Qiwa correction initiative is available for your record.

If you are a domestic worker, use Musaned and the domestic-worker rules.

Do not pay an unofficial person for guaranteed huroob removal. The safest path is the one shown by Qiwa, MHRSD, Absher or Musaned for your exact case.
